Which three are prerequisites for using the MySQL Database Service? (Choose three.)

A customer wants to use Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) for storing application backups which can be stored for months, but retrieved immediately based on business needs.
Which OCI storage service can be used to meet this requirement?
The DBA has determined that number of OCPU assigned to an Autonomous Database does not provide sufficient performance. Which option does the DBA have in this case?
A. No downtime is required as number of OCPU can be increased from OCI console, but users have to be informed that they must not use any application for at least one hour.
B. Open the database in OCI Console and increase the number of OCPU. No downtime required.
C. Plan for a one-hour downtime and increase the number of OCPU while database is offline.
D. Call Oracle Cloud Support and raise a request to increase number of OCPU. Expect a downtime of approximately one hour.

A. Operator Access Control can terminate Oracle operator connections.
B. Allow network connections in the Oracle public cloud.
C. Allow only the Oracle Staff to perform control access.
D. Secure access configured to the customer network.
Which two locations can be used to store your DB system database backups? (Choose two.)
A. You can store your DB system database backups in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Object Storage.
B. You can store your DB system database backups in on-premises local storage.
C. You can store your DB system database backups locally in the Fast Recovery Area of the DB system.

C. Internal Fabric and Customer VMs

Multicloud strategy eliminates the reliance of a single cloud provider but also provides which two advantages? (Choose two.)
